dct_title_s: Plan of Lyndale Farmstead showing proposed buildings and roads, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan of proposed buildings and roads for Lyndale Farmstead in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirty-eighth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page [72].
